note: Block is Methanospirillum/Methanoculleus/Methanolinea/Methanosphaerula/Methanoregula/Methanocorpusculum. The Methanolinea tarda genome supports hydrogenotrophy and formate use; Methanoculleus becomes prominent under high ammonium in digester communities (PMC8510171).
13 Methanosaeta (Methanothrix) ASVs. Obligate acetoclastic; reported as the ammonia-sensitive end of the methanogen spectrum.
Single Methanosaeta ASV separated by the tree.

Single Methanosaeta ASV separated from block b2 by the rank tree. Methanosaeta-dominated reactors have the lowest reported resilience to free ammonia; Smithella, Methanosaetaceae and Methanospirillaceae were inhibited together in ammonia dosing of digester sludge (PubMed 30278382).

5 Methanosarcina + 3 Methanomethylovorans ASVs. Methanosarcina occupies the intermediate/tolerant position in ammonium perturbation experiments and is repeatedly described as the ammonia-robust methanogen; Methanomethylovorans is methylotrophic. Genus identity alone does not resolve which pathway is active here.
Methanomassiliicoccus/Ca. Methanoplasma. A cultured representative reduced methanol with hydrogen; neither substrate alone supported methane formation.
5 Ca. Methanofastidiosum ASVs. Reconstructed genomes support methylated-thiol reduction; activity of these ASVs is not measured.
2 Ca. Methanomethylicus ASVs. Expectation from the described lineage; no primary source retrieved here.

role: proteolytic fermentation; acetate utilisation under ammonia stress
note: 5 Proteiniphilum ASVs. Proteolytic anaerobes isolated from a UASB reactor; Proteiniphilum and Methanothrix harundinacea were reported as dominant acetate utilisers under strong ammonia stress (PMC9853277). That report makes Proteiniphilum's direction here consistent with, not diagnostic of, ammonia stress.
6 Dysgonomonadaceae + Fermentimonas + 1 uncultured. Family-level expectation for fermentative Bacteroidota; no block-specific primary source retrieved.
53 ASVs spanning Rikenellaceae RC9, Paludibacter, Prevotella, Bacteroides, Petrimonas, Parabacteroides and uncultured members. Deliberately not given a single role: this block is a taxonomic mixture.
23 Fastidiosipila ASVs. Described members ferment amino acids; no block-specific primary source retrieved.

25 ASVs: Anaerovorax, Tissierella, Tepidimicrobium, Guggenheimella, Alkaliphilus and unclassified Anaerovoracaceae. The named genera are described amino-acid/amine fermenters; block-level activity is not measured.
Thermovirga + Acetomicrobium + uncultured Synergistaceae. The Thermovirga oil-well isolate uses amino acids and proteinaceous substrates; application to these ASVs is a hypothesis.
Aminobacterium, Lactivibrio, Syner-01 and uncultured Synergistaceae. Same family expectation as b1; the two blocks are separated by the tree and carry opposite coefficients in the acid-high model.

10 Syntrophomonas + Syntrophothermus + uncultured. Stable-isotope-informed metagenomics identified syntrophic butyrate degraders; Syntrophomonas is also repeatedly recovered alongside syntrophic acetate oxidisers in ammonia-loaded systems (PMC9600251).

12 Smithella + 3 Syntrophus + 3 uncultured. Smithella propionica is a propionate-oxidising syntroph; ammonia dosing of digester sludge inhibited Smithella together with Methanosaetaceae and Methanospirillaceae.
3 uncultured Syntrophaceae ASVs; genus unresolved, so the propionate role of b1 is not transferred.
3 Syntrophorhabdus ASVs. Described members oxidise aromatic compounds in syntrophy; no block-specific primary source retrieved.
Single Pelotomaculum ASV; described members oxidise propionate syntrophically.
